name: aos-chrome-companion
description: Exact-tab Chrome execution with proactive visual confirmation and one safe no-effect handoff to the official Extension.

interface.shortDescription: Exact-tab Chrome work with proactive visual proof.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the independently owned AOS Chrome Companion Extension and broker. Codex-task binding, grouped reusable tabs, exact-tab leases, proactive semantic-plus-screenshot readback, generation fencing, and no-replay errors keep concurrent Chrome work isolated. A terminal read-only no-effect failure may hand off once to a fresh target-scoped official Extension attempt.
defaultPrompt: Show the connected Chrome profile and Companion status.
Open isolated browser sessions on separate tabs.
Read and visually confirm the exact leased tab.
Use one safe official-Extension handoff only after terminal no-effect proof.
